(WebFetch extract — Al Jazeera's own reporting language)

Trump quotes, 28 July 2026, ahead of/around the White House meeting:
On Netanyahu and the Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site: "I don't need Bibi to tell me that." "Why didn't you just tell it to me, why did you have to announce it to the world?" "I know exactly what's going on at Pickaxe. It's not a big problem."
On Israel: "Frankly, we're being very nice to a lot of countries that would not survive without us. And you know who wouldn't survive without us? Israel."
On the relationship (28 July): "We have a little difference, but pretty close, yeah."

Netanyahu quotes (weekend of 26-27 July):
"But one way or the other, they have to end their nuclear program."
"If he can do so without returning to intense military fighting, that's fine. Why not?"
On the meeting: going "to hear what he has in mind" on Iran policy.

Context: Trump expressed frustration before the meeting, saying Netanyahu was pressuring him on Iran; followed a 13-day escalation and a June US-Iran memorandum.
